caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair as seen from the front. The chair has four rounded legs and two straight armrests. The backrest features three horizontal, slightly curved slats between two upright posts. The wood is a reddish-brown color throughout the frame, arms, and legs. The chair seat is made of a woven material in a light beige hue, forming a diagonal pattern. The background is plain and light tan, with no additional objects or elements present. The drawing includes a small artist’s signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Chair
